# netbox_notification_group (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
// Get a notification group by name
data "netbox_notification_group" "by_name" {
  name = "network-alerts"
}

// Get a notification group by ID
data "netbox_notification_group" "by_id" {
  id = "1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) At least one of `id` or `name` must be given.
- `name` (String) At least one of `id` or `name` must be given.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String)
- `group_ids` (Set of Number)
- `user_ids` (Set of Number)
